title: the chain of the search is proved by the behaviour of the pipeline and not by its wording
intent: The wave that repairs the proof of the track D (the wave D0) for the fourth time: the discriminator of the package of the waves 87 to 89 named two findings that touch it (F24, F25).  The code of the pipeline is honest; the proof was weaker than the promise.  The wave touches no file of the pipeline.  (1) **The probe of the one place was a probe of the wording** (F24): the check looked for five groups of words -- the command on the PATH, the type of the shell, the binary of the user in the profile, the store of nix, the binary of a tool -- and a step of the search written in other words was not seen, so the pipeline answered 0 where it had to answer 1.  (2) **Two probes of a copy of the chain were literal** (F25): the head of the chain was read as `find_tool()' with no space (`find_tool ()' is the same function and was not seen), and the pair of the steps of the profile was read as `-x ... .nix-profile/bin/' with both markers on one line -- so a full second chain that overlapped the common one passed.  (3) **The new proof is behavioural and not textual**: a copy of the tree whose chain hands out a **decoy instrument** -- a PlantUML that writes a picture with a mark of its own and an Emacs that writes a mark and calls the Emacs of the machine -- is drawn by the pipeline.  A pipeline that takes the instrument from the chain draws the pictures of the decoy; a pipeline that searches for the instrument by itself draws the pictures of the machine and leaves no mark of the decoy at all.  The check demands the mark in every picture of the copy and the mark of the Emacs of the chain, and it says that it cannot measure the chain when the decoy is not in it -- a check that cannot measure says so and does not pretend.  The textual probes are kept as a supplement: the head of the chain is read with a space or without it, the definition of the chain is looked for in every file of `scripts/', and the steps are looked for in the whole of a file and not in one line of it, in the code of the file and not in its text.
objection: The claim is about a proof and not about a picture of the site: the check runs the pipeline in a copy of the tree and reads the pictures it wrote, but the pictures of the site itself are the waves D3 and D4.  The price is named and it is four prices.  (a) The decoy proves that **the pipeline of that copy** takes the instrument from the chain: a pipeline that takes the instrument from the chain for one diagram and searches for it by itself for another is seen only in part, and the check demands the mark in every picture of the copy, so a part that searches for itself is caught -- but a part that searches for itself and draws a picture that is not in the copy is not.  (b) The probe reads the **code** of the files of `scripts/', not the trace of the runtime: a step assembled on the fly (`c=comm; $c -v plantuml') is not seen, and that is named.  (c) The decoy costs a run of the pipeline, so the check is slower than it was: the file of the check is 1165 lines and 47.9 kB (the wave 89 one was 1015 lines and 40.6 kB) and it goes in 24 to 26 seconds.  (d) **The boundary of the behavioural probe is named and it is not the boundary of this wave**: the decoy sees a copy of the chain that **resolves the instrument in the environment of the decoy**, and it does not see a copy that resolves it in a place that the environment of the decoy does not provide; a copy of the chain in **another script of `scripts/`** that hides its steps in its own file and is called without a glob is seen by the *textual* probes when it writes a step of the search in the words of the code, and a step that is assembled on the fly is not seen by them either; the promise of the claim says that the chain is proved by the behaviour of the pipeline and names the textual probes as a supplement.  **Amendment of 2026-11-21 (the wave 94):** the words that this price wrote -- "the behavioural probe sees it only if the copy shadows the chain, and a copy that does not shadow it is invisible" -- were false: a copy that shadows the chain and resolves the instrument in the environment of the decoy was not seen, as the discriminator of the package of the waves 90 to 92 showed; the boundary above replaces them.
refuted_by: a step of the chain of the search does not work alone, or the chain of the search is copied in a second place, or the pipeline does not read the chain from the place where it lives, or the pipeline writes a step of the search of a tool by itself, or the pipeline takes the instrument from anywhere but the chain of the search, or the pipeline renders one theme only, or a diagram of the tree is not drawn, or a picture is not drawn from its own source, or a picture is drawn from a part of its source, or the pipeline answers with the code 0 when the tool is not there, or the pipeline answers with the code 0 when PlantUML fails or writes no picture, or the skins of the themes do not carry the colours of the site, or the control of the claim does not make the check fail by its own assertion
note: The claim of the wave is amended and not rewritten: the id `the-diagram-pipeline-renders-both-themes' is the same, the text says that the chain of the search is proved by the **behaviour** of the pipeline -- a copy of the tree whose chain hands out a decoy instrument must draw the pictures of the decoy -- and that the textual probes of the wording are a supplement; the `falsifier' names the new refusal, and the `control' is the same.  Nine controls were applied to copies of the tree on 2026-11-20 -- five by the writer of the wave and four more by the parent, and the parent's four were made independently of the report of the writer.  Every one of them ended with the verdict the control asked for.  (1) The honest tree -- the code 0, in 24 to 26 seconds.  (2) A second chain that overlaps the common one -- the head with a space, the step of the profile split over two lines, the copy sourced **after** `tools.sh' -- the new check answers 1 and the old check of wave 89 answers 0: the false green the finding is about is measured.  (3) A chain of its own in another script of `scripts/' -- the code 1.  (4) **The parent's own mutation, twice redone**: the first attempt did not apply at all (the function of the pipeline is called `find_plantuml' and not `find_plantuml_here'), and the second attempt broke the syntax of `scripts/dev' and the check answered 2 (blocked) instead of 1 -- a check that cannot measure is not a refusal.  The third attempt, with `bash -n' before the run, gives the code 1 with the message of the decoy: "the pipeline answered 3 in the tree where the chain of the search hands out the decoy of the instrument: the pipeline does not take the instrument from the chain (scripts/lib/tools.sh)".  The mutation walks the PATH by itself, in words that the dictionary of the steps does not hold, so only the behavioural probe can see it.  (5) A second chain that the old check cannot see at all -- the head with a space and `type -p' instead of `command -v' -- the old check answers 0 and the new one answers 1: "the chain of the search is defined in [scripts/lib/plantuml.sh scripts/lib/tools.sh ] and not in one place" and "the steps of the chain of the search are in scripts/lib/plantuml.sh".  (6) The control of the claim -- the code 1.  The measurement of the wave: the check is 1165 lines and 47.9 kB (the wave 89 one was 1015 lines and 40.6 kB) and it goes in 24 to 26 seconds; the files of the pipeline were not touched by this wave.
